content: Formally, each word/mention has a global embedding INLINEFORM0 , and multiple sense embeddings INLINEFORM1 . Each sense embedding INLINEFORM2 refers to an entity embedding INLINEFORM3 , while the difference between INLINEFORM4 and INLINEFORM5 is that INLINEFORM6 models the co-occurrence information of an entity in texts (via hyperlinks) and INLINEFORM7 encodes the structured entity relations in KBs. More details can be found in the original paper.
